exposure: prenatal ultrasound assessment of bowel conditions
outcome: Concordance between prenatal ultrasound and surgical findings
finding: Planned elective preterm delivery for gastroschisis was associated with a high survival rate (96.72%), and neonates with complex gastroschisis had longer hospital stays and time to full enteral feeding compared to those with simple gastroschisis.
mod_finding: The caesarean delivery protocol demonstrated safety, high survival rate, primary closure, and favourable outcomes compared to other reports.
